slides.texte_overlay:
Rules for your first
real job as a man

1. Be there 10 minutes early

The first month decides
your reputation.

2. Write everything down

Never ask the same
question twice.

3. Learn everyone's name

The receptionist matters
as much as the boss.

4. Ask for feedback
before you're asked

"What can I do better?"

5. Don't complain
in the break room

Walls talk.

6. Keep learning outside work

The job pays you.
The learning pays you more.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. Keep learning outside work

Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
The learning pays you more.
